scene.label: Act 2, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. Rossillon. A room in the Countess's palace.
scene.location: Rossillon. A room in the Countess's palace.

lines.text: Come on, sir; I shall now put you to the height of your breeding.
lines.plainText: Come on sir I shall now put you to the height of your breeding

lines.text: I will show myself highly fed and lowly taught. I know my business is but to the court.
lines.plainText: I will show myself highly fed and lowly taught I know my business is but to the court

lines.text: To the court! Why, what place make you special, when you put off that with such contempt? But to the court!
lines.plainText: To the court Why what place make you special when you put off that with such contempt But to the court

lines.text: Truly, madam, if God have lent a man any manners, he may easily put it off at court: he that cannot make a leg, put off's cap, kiss his hand, and say nothing, has neither leg, hands, lip, nor cap; and indeed such a fellow, to say precisely, were not for the court; but for me, I have an answer will serve all men.
lines.plainText: Truly madam if God have lent a man any manners he may easily put it off at court he that cannot make a leg put off's cap kiss his hand and say nothing has neither leg hands lip nor cap and indeed such a fellow to say precisely were not for the court but for me I have an answer will serve all men

lines.text: Marry, that's a bountiful answer that fits all questions.
lines.plainText: Marry that's a bountiful answer that fits all questions

lines.text: It is like a barber's chair, that fits all buttocks—the pin-buttock, the quatch-buttock, the brawn-buttock, or any buttock.
lines.plainText: It is like a barber's chair that fits all buttocksthe pinbuttock the quatchbuttock the brawnbuttock or any buttock

lines.text: Will your answer serve fit to all questions?
lines.plainText: Will your answer serve fit to all questions

lines.text: As fit as ten groats is for the hand of an attorney, as your French crown for your taffety punk, as Tib's rush for Tom's forefinger, as a pancake for Shrove-Tuesday, a morris for May-day, as the nail to his hole, the cuckold to his horn, as a scolding quean to a wrangling knave, as the nun's lip to the friar's mouth; nay, as the pudding to his skin.
lines.plainText: As fit as ten groats is for the hand of an attorney as your French crown for your taffety punk as Tib's rush for Tom's forefinger as a pancake for ShroveTuesday a morris for Mayday as the nail to his hole the cuckold to his horn as a scolding quean to a wrangling knave as the nun's lip to the friar's mouth nay as the pudding to his skin

lines.text: Have you, I say, an answer of such fitness for all questions?
lines.plainText: Have you I say an answer of such fitness for all questions

lines.text: From below your duke to beneath your constable, it will fit any question.
lines.plainText: From below your duke to beneath your constable it will fit any question

lines.text: It must be an answer of most monstrous size that must fit all demands.
lines.plainText: It must be an answer of most monstrous size that must fit all demands

lines.text: But a trifle neither, in good faith, if the learned should speak truth of it. Here it is, and all that belongs to't. Ask me if I am a courtier; it shall do you no harm to learn.
lines.plainText: But a trifle neither in good faith if the learned should speak truth of it Here it is and all that belongs to't Ask me if I am a courtier it shall do you no harm to learn

lines.text: To be young again, if we could: I will be a fool in question, hoping to be the wiser by your answer. I pray you, sir, are you a courtier?
lines.plainText: To be young again if we could I will be a fool in question hoping to be the wiser by your answer I pray you sir are you a courtier

lines.text: O Lord, sir! There's a simple putting off. More, more, a hundred of them.
lines.plainText: O Lord sir There's a simple putting off More more a hundred of them

lines.text: Sir, I am a poor friend of yours, that loves you.
lines.plainText: Sir I am a poor friend of yours that loves you

lines.text: O Lord, sir! Thick, thick; spare not me.
lines.plainText: O Lord sir Thick thick spare not me

lines.text: I think, sir, you can eat none of this homely meat.
lines.plainText: I think sir you can eat none of this homely meat

lines.text: O Lord, sir! Nay, put me to't, I warrant you.
lines.plainText: O Lord sir Nay put me to't I warrant you

lines.text: You were lately whipp'd, sir, as I think.
lines.plainText: You were lately whipp'd sir as I think

lines.text: O Lord, sir! Spare not me.
lines.plainText: O Lord sir Spare not me

lines.text: Do you cry 'O Lord, sir!' at your whipping, and 'spare not me'? Indeed your 'O Lord, sir!' is very sequent to your whipping. You would answer very well to a whipping, if you were but bound to't.
lines.plainText: Do you cry 'O Lord sir' at your whipping and 'spare not me' Indeed your 'O Lord sir' is very sequent to your whipping You would answer very well to a whipping if you were but bound to't

lines.text: I ne'er had worse luck in my life in my 'O Lord, sir!' I see things may serve long, but not serve ever.
lines.plainText: I ne'er had worse luck in my life in my 'O Lord sir' I see things may serve long but not serve ever

lines.text: I play the noble housewife with the time, to entertain it so merrily with a fool.
lines.plainText: I play the noble housewife with the time to entertain it so merrily with a fool

lines.text: O Lord, sir! Why, there't serves well again.
lines.plainText: O Lord sir Why there't serves well again

lines.text: An end, sir! To your business. Give Helen this,
lines.plainText: An end sir To your business Give Helen this

lines.text: And urge her to a present answer back.
lines.plainText: And urge her to a present answer back

lines.text: Commend me to my kinsmen and my son.
lines.plainText: Commend me to my kinsmen and my son

lines.text: This is not much.
lines.plainText: This is not much

lines.text: Not much commendation to them?
lines.plainText: Not much commendation to them

lines.text: Not much employment for you. You understand me?
lines.plainText: Not much employment for you You understand me

lines.text: Most fruitfully. I am there before my legs.
lines.plainText: Most fruitfully I am there before my legs

lines.text: Haste you again.
lines.plainText: Haste you again
